purpose: Independent clinic-reception background chatter; no principal dialogue is reused.

voices.text: Hi, I am here for my ten thirty appointment. Yes, I can confirm my address at the desk. Thank you.
The pharmacy is through the corridor on your right. Please take the requisition with you when you go.
Excuse me, does the lab still accept walk-ins this afternoon, or should I book a time online?
You can complete the first page in the waiting area. Bring it back when your name is called.
